title: RWB-S5-E3024-APP: the stock balance has no figure definition, no write operation for its confirmation, no object in the TSD, no requirement id, and its two take-on rules are owned by sibling stories
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 DP table, R7.3 fill order and R9; Work Package B2-S5-006 story line (H RWB-S5-E3024-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON, C, I and X empty; acs AC1 to AC4; reqs empty); FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 A1.3, A2.6.1, A2.6.2, A2.6.3.1, A2.6.3.2, A2.6.3.3 and A2.6.4; TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T6.1, T8 and T-A.1; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13 (S5 row), 19 (rwb-asset IN and OUT), 29, 37, 41 and 43; legacy RWB-E3-024 sections Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks, Validation and messages, Test cases and Guardrails
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies); Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.6, 12.7 and 13
description: One combined row for the story. (1) The figure: legacy AC1 says the screen gives the stock balance 'a number' and the FSD repeats it, but no source says which number (a count of assets, the book value, the holding cost, the sale value, or several of them) or over which scope and as-at date; FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 gives a field catalog of ACE asset fields and no balance object, TSD S5 T3.1 declares asset, listing and asset_sale only, and the Ownership Map table list holds only asset_sale and listing for S5. (2) The write: FSD S5 A2.6.2 says the officer 'enters or confirms the values' and the system 'writes the decision log or interaction ledger entry', but no source names an operation for that confirmation: the legacy endpoint table, TSD S5 T-A.1 and the Ownership Map list GET /assets, GET /assets/{assetId}, GET /assets/{assetKey}, POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations, POST /assets/{assetId}/listings and POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds and nothing else, and POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations is rwb-valuation's under ASM-A6-api-6. (3) The owner: FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 names the NPA and asset manager as primary role and the Head of NPA as also-user, and TSD S5 T6.1 gives RW-NPAMGR CRU and RW-HEADNPA RA in the Asset and disposal area, but no source says that a role is the 'owner' the legacy screen asks for, nor how the owner is scoped. (4) The duplication: legacy RWB-E3-024 AC2 is R-DIS-01 and AC3 is R-DIS-02, the same two criteria that RWB-E3-019 and RWB-E3-020 already carry and that their app stories build, so the WP's list of four owned criteria assigns this story two criteria whose write path belongs to sibling stories. (5) The ACE read: the legacy Data table names recovery_case, assignment, v_ace_account and v_ace_npa_asset, while Architecture v5 slides 13, 29, 37 and 45 give the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone and give the S5 row no call to P1; the two sources conflict and R3 source precedence puts the Arch v5 catalogue slides first. (6) The requirement id: TSD S5 T8 maps REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-005 to FEAT-AST-01 and REQ-S5-006 to REQ-S5-010 to FEAT-AST-08, so no requirement is mapped to FEAT-AST-06 and the WP's reqs list is empty. (7) The event: DP-09 is not in the pattern set, so no event and no outbox is written even though the balance changes whenever a take-on lands.
evidence: FSD S5 A2.6.1 'Gives the stock balance an owner and a number on one screen. It has no owner today'; FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 field catalog rows v_ace_npa_asset.asset_key, v_ace_collateral.asset_key, asset_ref, asset_code, asset_type, transfer_in_type, from_segment, transfer_in_date; FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 roles 'NPA and asset manager Primary' and 'Head of NPA Also uses'; TSD S5 T3.1 tables asset, listing and asset_sale only; TSD S5 T-A.1 rows API-S5-001 to API-S5-005 with no confirmation operation; TSD S5 T8 traceability rows REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-010 mapping FEAT-AST-01 and FEAT-AST-08 only; legacy RWB-E3-024 Endpoints table GET /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId} and POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations; Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45 '30 recovery.v_ace_* views read only by rwb-source-data'; slide 13 S5 row with T (P7) and E (S4), T E (S6), T E (S9) and no P1 call
area: Business definition, API and contract, data ownership, traceability
owner_role: Business analyst S5 with the solution architect and the rwb-access owner
proposed: Fix the figure as the count of asset rows with the totals of book_value and holding_cost_to_date per holding_status for a scope of LOV-SEGMENT and an as-at date, computed from rwb_asset and stored in no table; serve it on GET /assets as an AssetStockBalance element and confirm it with one POST on the asset base whose path is reserved and published with the next API Specification version; make the accountable owner the role code RW-NPAMGR with its scope, resolved from the rwb-access matrix; record that R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 are built by RWB-S5-E3019-APP and RWB-S5-E3020-APP and that this story proves its criteria on the balance they move; read the ACE facts on the rwb-source-data data-product contract only; publish no event; and map the feature to a requirement id in the next TSD S5 and PRD versions.

title: RWB-S5-E3024-CON: the balance element, the confirmation operation and the owner field have no published shape, path or source, and the split plan sets the contract dependency row to None
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 DP table, R7.2 section 12 and R9; Work Package B2-S5-006 story line (CON slice with acs empty, C empty); FSD S5 A2.6.2, A2.6.3.2, A2.6.3.3 and A2.6.4; TSD S5 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1, T8 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 19, 29, 37, 41 and 42; Ownership Map rows for asset_sale, listing, decision_log_entry, rule_row, recovery_case and assignment; Architecture v5 slide 43 event table
section: Metadata (Contract dependencies); Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 (AC1 to AC5), 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.5 and 12.7
description: One combined row for the contract baseline. (1) The confirmation operation has no path, request or answer in any source: the FSD endpoint table, TSD S5 T-A.1 and the Ownership Map give the six asset operations, none of which confirms a balance, so the baseline carries the path as a placeholder and the element names StockBalanceConfirmation and AssetStockBalance are this story's design. (2) The AssetStockBalance element has no published shape: no source names its properties (count, book-value total, holding-cost total, owner, as-at date, record reference) or their required flags. (3) The owner field has no data source: FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 gives the roles and TSD S5 T6.1 the rights, but no source says that the owner is a role code resolved from the rwb-access matrix rather than a parameter of rwb-case (DP-06) or a reference-data row (DP-07), and neither DP-06 nor DP-07 is in the pattern set. (4) The consumed rows carry no operation names: the rwb-source-data DP06 read and the rwb-case case-move answer are named as contracts by Architecture v5 slide 13 and slide 19 and by the Ownership Map, but not by any path. (5) The plan's contract dependency row for this key is None although the baseline consumes three contracts of class C. (6) No requirement is mapped to FEAT-AST-06 in TSD S5 T8, so the baseline's traceability row carries the placeholder.
evidence: TSD S5 T-A.1 rows API-S5-001 to API-S5-005 with no confirmation; FSD S5 A2.6.2 step 3 'writes the decision log or interaction ledger entry and moves the case'; FSD S5 A2.6.3.3 role table; TSD S5 T6.1 RBAC matrix column 'Asset and disposal'; TSD S5 T8 mapping FEAT-AST-01 and FEAT-AST-08 only; Architecture v5 slide 13 S5 row with no P1 or P3 call letter; slide 19 IN/OUT of rwb-asset without a balance event; slide 42 notes on the error envelope and backward compatibility; work package dependency rows of the CON slice
owner_role: Solution architect with the tech lead of rwb-asset and the rwb-access contract owner
proposed: Publish the confirmation as one POST on /api/recovery/asset/v1 with the StockBalanceConfirmation request and the AssetStockBalance answer in the next API Specification version, declare the balance element and its required flags there, declare the owner as a role code of the rwb-access matrix, add the three consumed rows to the contract dependency register, and map FEAT-AST-06 to a requirement id in the next TSD S5 version.
